audit.evidence: KubeBlocks uses a unified set of APIs (CRDs) and code to manage various databases on K8s. For example, we can use the `Cluster` resource to create a PostgreSQL cluster, a Redis cluster, or a Kafka cluster. This abstraction and unified API allow us to further use a single set of operator code to manage multiple types of databases, as well as handle day-2 operations, theoretically extending to any type of database engine. ／ KubeBlocks is an open-source control plane software that runs and manages multiple popular database engines on K8s through a unified set of code and APIs. The core of KubeBlocks is a K8s operator, which defines a set of CRDs to abstract the common attributes of various database engines and uses these abstractions to manage the engine's lifecycle and day-2 operations. ／ KubeBlocks manages various types of stateful engines, including RDBMSs (MySQL, PostgreSQL), Caches(Redis), NoSQLs (MongoDB), MQs(Kafka, Pulsar), vector databases(Milvus, Qdrant, Weaviate), and data warehouses(ClickHouse, ElasticSearch, OpenSearch, Doris, StarRocks). Adding a new engine to KubeBlocks can be achieved by writing a KubeBlocks Addon. The community is actively integrating more types of engines into KubeBlocks, and it currently supports 35 types of engines.

audit.evidence: Useful tips for designing a robust database schema. This guide is more of a decision reference (1) for people wanting to design better database schemas for startups (2). ／ - Decision reference: You will probably come across any one of the problems below when designing database schema (e.g. should I use `JSONB`? How do I design `tagging` schema? How do I keep historical records?) and be presented with different options and trade-offs. If two standards are equal (should table name be singular or plural), then it's up to you to pick one and make it a standard and keeping it consistent. Rather than giving you a `it depends` answer, this guide is meant to share the `what-ifs`, that is the decision I made, and the outcome. Yes, the codes are actually being written and used in different applications I wrote. You don't have to agree with the approaches - I used to take some of the more complex approaches (for the sake of _best practice_), but over time I realised that it is unnecessary. Simple is best. ／ - Startups: A lot of startups starts by using ORMs or frameworks that provides a lot of convenience when it comes to dealing with database. If you are thinking _hey, we need to be agile, that's why we are okay introducing some technical debts_ let me tell you something, you can be both fast and produce quality work (not compromising database design). Most of the time, when new features are being introduced, or when new situation aroses (e.g. analytics are not accurate, because we did not store timestamp with timezones in database, using integer id instead of uuid, and people start _hacking_ your system, etc), the application just won't cut it anymore. The last thing I want to live with is a poorly designed database schema. You can switch language and frameworks for your frontend/backend servers, but if you design your database wrongly, you have to live with it. Also, I mentioned `startups` because my knowledge on database design is limited to a user scale of `<5m`. Also, the approach taken by larger companies might vary, and the technology used might differ as they are focusing a lot on performance, reliability and running databases across the world. For this guide, we are talking specifically about `mysql` and `postgres`, and probably just running them in cloud providers like AWS/Google Cloud.

identity.one_liner: AliSQL，基于 MySQL 8.0.44 的分支，集成 DuckDB 分析引擎与向量检索
identity.review: 阿里云数据库团队维护的开源 MySQL 分支，在 MySQL 8.0.44 基础上加入 DuckDB 列式分析存储引擎、HNSW 向量索引、Native Flashback 历史查询及 binlog 优化，保留 MySQL 客户端协议。面向需要在一套 MySQL 实例内同时处理分析与向量负载的开发者，需自行从源码构建（依赖 CMake、GCC/Clang 等），向量功能默认关闭且要求 RC 隔离级别。
highlights: 提供 DuckDB 列式存储引擎，支持分析表的列式执行与自动压缩
提供 VECTOR 类型和 HNSW 向量索引，支持 COSINE 与 EUCLIDEAN 距离，向量最高 16383 维
提供 Native Flashback（AS OF TIMESTAMP 查询历史 InnoDB 数据）与 binlog 持久化到 redo 等优化
use_cases: 在 MySQL 协议下对分析型表执行列式查询（TPC-H 场景示例）
为 AI 应用提供原生向量存储与近似最近邻检索
需要闪回查询历史数据或优化大事务 binlog 提交的 MySQL 运维场景

This release is based on MySQL 8.0.44 and adds a DuckDB analytical storage engine, HNSW vector indexes, Native Flashback, and binlog optimizations while retaining the MySQL client

identity.one_liner: BinExport：反汇编导出插件，将 IDA/Binary Ninja/Ghidra 反汇编输出为 Protocol Buffer
identity.review: BinExport 是 BinDiff 的导出组件，以插件形式嵌入 IDA Pro、Binary Ninja 和 Ghidra，把反汇编数据导出为 Protocol Buffer、统计文本或调试文本格式，供 BinDiff 使用。面向二进制分析人员，支持 IDC/IDAPython 脚本调用与 Ghidra headless 模式，README 注明其并非 Google 官方产品。
highlights: 提供 IDA Pro、Binary Ninja、Ghidra 三类反汇编工具的插件
支持导出 Protocol Buffer 全量数据、统计文本与调试文本格式
支持 IDC/IDAPython 脚本调用与 Ghidra headless 批处理导出
use_cases: 为 BinDiff 生成其所需的 Protocol Buffer 格式反汇编数据
批量导出二进制分析结果用于流程自动化

classification.eco_why: README 未显示其与数据库的适配或依赖关系，仅 topic 含 database 且 IDA 分析数据内部称 database，证据不足

audit.evidence: BinExport is the exporter component of ／ the the disassemblers IDA Pro, Binary Ninja and Ghidra that exports disassembly ／ data into the Protocol Buffer format that BinDiff requires.

identity.one_liner: Aplus 框架的 PHP 会话管理库
identity.review: Aplus Framework 生态中的会话管理库，提供基于 cookie、文件、数据库及 memcached 等方式的会话处理能力，通过 Composer 安装，面向使用 Aplus 框架或全栈 PHP 开发的开发者。README 极简，仅含文档与测试链接，具体功能细节需查阅用户指南。
highlights: 提供会话（session）管理功能库
支持通过 Composer 包管理器分发（packagist）
主题标签显示支持 cookie、database、files、memcached 等会话存储方式
use_cases: PHP/Web 应用中的用户会话状态管理
Aplus Framework 全栈开发项目的会话组件

classification.eco_why: README 仅列库名与链接，未说明是否为数据库生态提供服务，主题标签含 database/memcached 但无正文证据

audit.evidence: Aplus Framework Session Library ／ tests ／ packagist

identity.one_liner: 面向数据库的 GraphQL CRUD API 规范
identity.review: OpenCRUD 定义了一套基于 GraphQL 的标准 CRUD API 规范，覆盖查询、过滤、聚合、变更、订阅等领域，并提供 SDL 用于数据建模。它本身不含运行时实现，需由兼容项目（如 GraphCMS，另有多个标注 planned 的项目）落地。MySQL 与 MongoDB 被列为提供 API 变体的数据库。适合 API 设计者与工具开发者参考实现。
highlights: 定义 GraphQL CRUD API 规范，含查询、过滤、聚合、嵌套变更、订阅等章节
提供非规范性的 SDL 数据建模规范
为 MySQL、MongoDB 等多种数据库提供 API 变体
use_cases: 为数据库生成标准化 CRUD 风格 GraphQL API
构建围绕 CRUD API 的通用工具链
作为 API 设计参考规范

db_verdicts.quote: OpenCRUD is a fully GraphQL compliant query language to access and modify data. OpenCRUD provides API flavours for many popular databases including MySQL and MongoDB.

classification.eco_why: README 定位其为数据库服务的 API 规范，为数据库生态提供标准化 CRUD 接口层

audit.evidence: OpenCRUD is a GraphQL CRUD API specification for databases ／ OpenCRUD is a fully GraphQL compliant query language to access and modify data. OpenCRUD provides API flavours for many popular databases including MySQL and MongoDB. ／  - Focus on API, not implementation/runtime characteristics

identity.one_liner: 为 ActiveRecord 迁移提供数据库约束 DSL 的 Ruby gem
identity.review: Rein 是一个 Ruby gem，通过在 ActiveRecord 迁移中添加一组可逆的方法，让开发者以声明式 DSL 添加外键、唯一、排除、CHECK 等数据库级约束，而不必手写 SQL；面向使用 Rails/ActiveRecord 的开发者，特性（如可延迟约束、EXCLUDE/GiST）表明主要面向 PostgreSQL 数据库。
highlights: 在 ActiveRecord 迁移中提供外键、唯一、排除、CHECK、长度、正则匹配、数值等约束方法
DSL 方法自动可逆，支持 Rails 可逆迁移
支持约束延迟校验（deferred/deferrable）与 NOT VALID、if 条件等选项
use_cases: Rails 项目在数据库层声明数据完整性约束
替代迁移中手写 SQL 约束语句
需要可延迟（deferred）约束校验的事务场景

db_verdicts.quote: Postgres ／ docs](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/9.0/static/ddl-constraints.html#DDL-CONSTRAINTS-EXCLUSION)

classification.eco_why: 作为 gem 为 ActiveRecord/数据库迁移流程提供约束 DSL，属于为数据库生态服务的开发库
